campaigns.label: Kaiserreich Test
campaigns.description: Test instance for the hoi4-kr reference data. The map is a land/sea render of Kaiserreich's own province bitmap (tools/render_basemap.py), so pins can be checked against the same data their coordinates came from. Twelve hand-written events exercise country aliases, state vs city locations, and KR's pre-revolutionary place names.
